_comment: muChat example configuration. Copy to config.json and fill in your own values. NEVER commit a filled-in config.json, credentials, or queue/state files.

env.MUCHAT_BIND_HOST: bind address for the notify HTTP server (private network only, never public)
env.MUCHAT_NODE_BIN: path to a Node >= 22.13 binary for the official send driver
env.MUCHAT_SEND_DRIVER: path to the compiled official send driver (see official-send/NOTICE)
env.HTTPS_PROXY: egress proxy, if your host needs one to reach iLink

credentials_path: pairs/<pair_id>/state/credentials.json (mode 0600; created by bridge/login.py --wait after QR confirmation; contains bot_token, baseurl, ilink_bot_id, ilink_user_id -- never commit, never log, never print)
